title: Time-Restricted Eating Prediabetes Dataset Metadata template schema
description: Time-Restricted Eating Prediabetes Dataset Metadata template schema generated by the CEDAR Artifact Library

propertyDescriptions.Protocol Identifier: Short identifier assigned to the study protocol.
propertyDescriptions.Dataset Description: Summary of the dataset, study population, intervention, and main measurements.
propertyDescriptions.Synthetic Data: Whether the records are entirely synthetic and represent no real participants.
propertyDescriptions.License: License or reuse statement governing the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Study Condition: Health condition investigated by the study.
propertyDescriptions.Study Design: Biomedical investigation design used by the study.
propertyDescriptions.Comparator Description: Description of the comparison or control condition.
propertyDescriptions.Intervention Duration: Length of the intervention period in weeks.
propertyDescriptions.Eating Window: Daily eating-window duration for the time-restricted-eating arm.
propertyDescriptions.Participant Count: Number of participant records represented in the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Minimum Age: Minimum participant age allowed by the protocol.
propertyDescriptions.Maximum Age: Maximum participant age allowed by the protocol.
propertyDescriptions.Study Countries: Country in which a study site or participant record is located.
propertyDescriptions.Enrollment Start Date: Earliest enrollment date represented in the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Study End Date: Latest study visit or observation date represented in the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Specimen Type: Biological specimen used for laboratory measurements.
propertyDescriptions.Outcome Measure: Clinical or laboratory outcome measured in the study; values are selected from SNOMED CT.
propertyDescriptions.Dataset Variables: Variables present in the participant-level dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Measurement Units: Units represented by quantitative variables in the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Investigator ORCID: ORCID identifier for an investigator recorded in the dataset.
propertyDescriptions.Reference PMID: PubMed identifier for the supporting publication or reference.
propertyDescriptions.Protocol DOI: DOI assigned to the study protocol.
propertyDescriptions.Source Repository URL: Web location of the dataset, protocol, SOP, and supporting files.
